notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic land in library.
description:
Play Evolving Wilds.
Evolving Wilds enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Activate Evolving Wilds by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Evolving Wilds from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
